# ADR-0104: the figure sheet is carried byte for byte

## Context

The first portal shipped its own figure.css, written for the guide pages
and tuned by hand over the spring.

When present was built it copied that sheet and edited two rules to suit
the review layout — the caption margin and the legend gap.

The March skin work then changed the portal copy again, and by June the
two sheets differed in eleven rules, so a figure drawn for one surface
rendered differently on the other.

Two attempts to keep them aligned by review were made, and each failed
within a month.

## Decision

We have decided that the kit's figure.css should probably be carried byte
for byte by every product that carries the kit.

It seems best that a product sheet which differs by even one byte fails
the drift check, although a project could argue for an exception.

Products may add figure rules of their own, but only in a separate sheet
that is loaded after the kit sheet, which we think keeps the base intact.

## Consequences

Every product renders a figure the same way. Figure work happens once, in
the kit. The drift check keeps the sheets equal from now on.

## Architecture impact

None.
